Select entries along one dimension by index list.

| | |
| --- | --- |
| Category | [Shape Ops](../categories/shape-ops.md) |
| Status | Runs |
| Also read from graphs as | `TensorIndexSelect` |
| Search words | tensor, index, select, gather, slice |

## Inputs

| Pin | Type | Required | Connections | Meaning |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| **Input** | Tensor | Yes | 1 | Tensor from which values will be selected |

## Outputs

| Pin | Type | Required | Connections | Meaning |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| **Output** | Tensor | Yes | 1 | Tensor containing the selected entries |

## Settings

| Group | Setting | Key | Type | Default | Allowed values | Read by | Meaning |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Selection | Dimension | `dim` | Integer | `0` |   | The run | Dimension along which to select. |
| Selection | Indices | `indices` | Text | (empty) |   | The run | Comma-separated indices; negative indices count from the end. Required. |

**Read by** says whether a run uses the setting (**The run**) or only the editor, a dialog or a view (**The editor only**).

## Where it runs

| Where | Runs |
| --- | --- |
| Data pipeline (run the graph, **Run step**, previews) | No: TensorIndexSelect is a tensor graph operation node; PipelineExecutor tensor operation execution is not implemented |
| Training (the compiled model) | Yes, as a layer of the model: compiled and built as an indexed tensor selection layer |

The node runs on the device chosen for the run (CPU or a GPU); a node does not fix a device.
